note: Catalog of Teleon DESCENT demos — each is the same shape: an expensive default DAG descended to the cheapest viable path over the shared step library (architecture/pipeline_step_catalog.json) that still meets the requirement floor. 'live' demos compute their savings from real modules; 'ideated' demos carry a designed estimate (clearly labeled) + the DAG to build. serves_truth=false (a demo output is a candidate the verification rail dispositions). Savings %s for live demos are COMPUTED by scripts/demo_dashboard.py, never hand-typed.
